name: MEFIC REIT Fund
summary: MEFIC REIT Fund is a real estate investment trust. It aims to generate income on the invested capital by acquiring a number of recurring income-generating real estate assets. MEFIC REIT Fund’s portfolio includes residential, retail, hospitality, and office properties located in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Makkah, as well as Dubai in United Arab Emirates. The company was founded on February 18, 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
